description: Portal 2 sp_a4_intro with its five Wheatley monitors deployed (relay_deploy_straight). Each monitor is a func_monitor showing @wheatley_camera through _rt_Camera. The player (noclip) stands 190 units in front of wheatley_monitor1, the placement tools/quality/portal2_monitors.py derives from the BSP. Phases: facing (the screen fills the middle of the view) and away (turned 180 degrees: the screen is off-screen but still in the PVS, so the camera stays active and the legacy path still renders it). Run it as an A/B with --ab-build equal to --build and --ab-extra-arg +cl_drawmonitors 0 to measure what the monitor view costs. Frames come from the native Vulkan renderer (-vkframestats).
